metadata.name: drawershell-focus-trap-broken
metadata.description: CALIBRATION / PLANTED-ERROR fixture. Identical to bas/cases/interaction/drawershell-focus-trap.json except it targets DrawerShell@0.1.0, a real historical version that predates useFocusTrap (its version folder has no useFocusTrap.ts). Run this via BAS execute-adhoc: it MUST FAIL at assert-focus-trapped because focus escapes the panel after Tab. This proves the focus-trap playbook can actually detect a broken component, so a green run of the registered playbook is trustworthy. It is intentionally NOT under bas/cases/ so 'test-genie registry build' never registers it into the green suite.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] button'); if (b) b.focus(); return document.activeElement ? document.activeElement.tagName : 'NONE'; })()

metadata.label: Move focus to the in-panel close button
Press Tab twice to attempt to leave the panel

evaluate.expression: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); const inside = !!(p && p.contains(document.activeElement)); document.body.setAttribute('data-focus-trapped', inside ? 'yes' : 'no'); return inside; })()

metadata.label: Record whether focus stayed inside the dialog panel

assert.failure_message: EXPECTED CALIBRATION FAILURE: DrawerShell@0.1.0 has no focus trap, so focus escaped the panel after Tab. If this assertion PASSES, the focus-trap playbook is not actually discriminating and cannot be trusted.

metadata.label: Focus remained trapped inside the drawer (expected to FAIL here)
